# TeslaX

> TeslaX is an unofficial, portfolio concept page for Tesla Model S Plaid by denysovski. It is not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.; prices, dates and the cart are demo data.

The single page covers the Model S interior, in-car gaming, safety, the electric architecture, a model showcase (Model 3, Model Y, Model S, Model X), software updates, Tesla Energy (solar, Powerwall, Megapack), performance, ownership costs, a demo-drive form, updates, an FAQ and a look at future features.

- [Concept page](https://denysovski.github.io/TeslaFuturistic/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/denysovski/TeslaFuturistic)
- [Author](https://github.com/denysovski)
- [Official Tesla website](https://www.tesla.com/)
